main_text.p: ܥܕܘܬܐ Charitas longanimis est, attrahit spiritum, 1.ad Corinth.13.4.
ܐܪܟܐ ܠܥܝ Contractio, protractio, longitudo spiritus, id est, Longanimitas, patientia: Cum praefixa praepositione ܒ sumitur etiam adverbialiter; Patienter, μακροθύμως, Actor.26.3.
ܠܝ Syr.Longitudo: ܠܝ ܒܐ A' longitudine, id est, Longo tempore, Actor.26.5.
נגר Ch.Artifex,opifex, faber: נגר אַיִן Faber lignarius, Jesa.44.13. Sic Syr. ܢܓܪܐ ܕܥܘܢ Filius fabri, Matth.13.55. Plur. נגרין, נגריא.
נגרא, נגרא, נגרא Ch. Vectis, Pessulus. Plur. נגרין, נגרין.
נגר טורא Ch.Gallus sylvestris, vel montanus, respondet Hebraeo דוכיפת, Levit.11.19.
נגש Ch.Ferire, Cornupetere, Idem quod נגח, Exo. 21.28.&32.in Targ. Jonathanis.
נרא נרה Ch.Spargi,aspergi,Heb.נזה. Aphel אַרִי Sparsit, consperfit, aspersit, insperfit, perfperfit.
נרב Ithpah. אתנדב Ch. Sponte, voluntarie aliquid agere, dare, vel offerre, Sponte offerri, vel offerre se.
נדבא נדבתא, נדבת Ch. Voluntarium, oblatio voluntaria,

page.notes: Syriac, Chaldee and Hebrew words are rendered approximately; the vowel points and exact letter forms of the Oriental type are uncertain in several places and are marked as best read.
